categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: toy business, game business, and football club business. The toy segment focuses on remote control car models, alloy car models, building block toys, infant toys, and outdoor riding products. The game segment develops and operates network games, specializing in ancient-style strategy and idle game categories with multiple IP licenses. The football club segment manages the Spanish football club Espanyol, generating revenue from broadcasting rights, ticket sales, sponsorships, player transfers, and merchandise.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The toy business employs advanced R&D technologies including CAD, electronic digital technology, and automotive-grade 3D printing, with a focus on intelligent interactive technologies such as VR spatial positioning and AI voice assistants. The game business emphasizes continuous innovation with patented technologies in game account data sharing, distributed unique ID generation, and virtual time implementation, integrating AI technologies like DeepSeek, ChatGPT, and AIGC for art design, content planning, and user interaction. The football club utilizes AI models for sports management and player talent identification.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The toy business serves global consumers through over 400 products sold in more than 120 countries, including partnerships with major car manufacturers like BMW, Ferrari, and Audi. The game business targets players in China, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, Japan, Southeast Asia, Europe, and North America, leveraging popular IPs to attract diverse user groups. The football club business caters to football fans worldwide, especially Spanish-speaking populations, with a strong presence in Spain, China, and other international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China, including Guangdong, Shantou, Guangzhou, and other regions, with significant overseas operations in Spain (football club), Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea, Mexico, and Southeast Asia. The toy business exports globally, covering Europe, North America, Latin America, Asia, and Oceania. The game business has a global footprint with localized operations in multiple countries and regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the supply chain with upstream R&D and manufacturing in toys, midstream game development and publishing, and downstream football club management and marketing. It maintains a full industry chain ecosystem integrating research, production, sales, and global distribution channels, as well as football club operations including player development and commercial activities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on expanding product portfolios and market reach, deepening IP resource utilization, and embracing AI technologies to enhance product innovation and operational efficiency. R&D priorities include developing intelligent toys with AI interaction, innovating game content with AI-driven NPCs and multi-platform adaptation (e.g., Huawei HarmonyOS), and applying AI in sports management. The company also plans to strengthen long-life cycle game operations and global multi-version management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales in the toy segment, game sales and in-game virtual item purchases in the game segment, and multiple streams in the football club segment including broadcasting rights, ticketing, sponsorships, player transfers, and merchandise sales. The company also earns licensing fees from IP partnerships and collects rental income from investment properties.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the toy and interactive entertainment industry in China, recognized as a high-tech enterprise with strong IP partnerships and global brand presence. In the game sector, it competes with major domestic and international game developers by focusing on niche strategy and idle game genres and leveraging popular IPs. It is the first A-share listed company to control a European top-tier football club, positioning itself uniquely in the sports entertainment market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 1.36 billion, a 21.49% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 457.7 million. The toy business showed revenue growth of 20.28% and profit growth of 40.17%, while the game and football club segments experienced declines due to increased R&D and promotion expenses and football club operational losses. The company has total assets of about RMB 3.79 billion and is undergoing a recovery phase with strategic cost control and market expansion plans.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes innovation-driven product development, integrating advanced AI and interactive technologies into toys and games to enhance user experience and educational value. It leverages exclusive and licensed IPs from globally renowned automotive brands and popular game franchises to differentiate its offerings. The football club business capitalizes on the unique cultural heritage and global fan base of Espanyol, combining sports performance with brand marketing and digital engagement to create a comprehensive entertainment ecosystem.
